Name: Clockwork Fowlbeast Parrot Replacer
Author: Eilinsamoma
Description:
将鹦鹉蛋＆鹦鹉蛋的名字与简介＆鹦鹉替换为明日方舟中衡沙的召唤物发条羽兽。
（我对贴图中的发条羽兽的尾巴做了一些改动，它跟原本的设计不一样，因为对我来说这样看上去更加好看，主要是因为文件给的像素尺寸太小了。）

确保你安装了[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]，否则不会生效。﻿

Replace the Parrot egg ＆ ParrotbEgg's name and description & Parrot with the Sand Reckonerg's Clockwork Fowlbeast by Arknights.
（I made some changes to the tail of the Clockwork Fowlbea ,it is different from the original design, because it looks better to me,Mainly because the pixel size given by the file is too small.）

Make sure you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] installed, otherwise it won't work.
